title: PalmSync
subtitle: Biometric wellness device, 1st Place at the Asearis Hackathon
pitch: A dual-purpose biometric wellness device that combines real-time stress monitoring with smart ambient lighting, taken from concept to a working prototype in under 6 weeks.
highlights: 1st Place, Asearis Hackathon (team of 3; team captain)
PPG, EDA, and thermal sensing on a wireless ESP32
BOM trade-offs against a $14.82 BOM target and a $49.99 retail target
Validated sensor accuracy and signal stability across environmental conditions

blocks.md: PalmSync reads heart rate and HRV (PPG), electrodermal activity (EDA), and temperature on a wireless ESP32, with an AI-powered analytics layer on top. As Team Captain & Product Lead, I led a 3-engineer team from concept to a working prototype in under 6 weeks and built the AI analytics layer myself.

blocks.heading: Product work
items: Ran BOM trade-offs against a $14.82 BOM target, balancing cost, wearability, and manufacturability.
Positioned the product at a $49.99 retail target.
Built structured test procedures and validated sensor accuracy and signal stability across environmental conditions.
Built the business strategy and a consumer and medical-grade product roadmap.
